subject: Daikoku volcano
topic: This is the inside of an active underwater volcano.
script:
This is the inside of an active underwater volcano.
NOAA's robot dropped into the crater of Daikoku Seamount, in the western Pacific.
Thick clouds of volcanic smoke filled the water.
Plumes of gas, likely carbon dioxide and sulfur, poured out of cracks along the crater walls.
All signs that this volcano had erupted recently.
Back in two thousand six, scientists found something even stranger here: a pool of liquid sulfur.
And yet, animals live here. Tubeworms, crabs, and crowds of flatfish specialized for this sulfur-rich ground.
For them, this toxic crater is home.
Would you dive into a volcano?
